briefdescription.para: Unit and integration tests for the distributed ingestion coordinator.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests cover:
InProcessLeaderElection: acquisition, renewal, revocation, expiry, contention between two nodes
ConsistentHashRing: add/remove nodes, consistent key mapping, wrap-around, empty-ring sentinel, even distribution
InProcessWorkerNode: availability flag, empty-source fast path
IngestionCoordinator: construction, start/stop lifecycle, partitioning, ingestAll with no-sources, ingestAll happy path, leader-acquisition failure, custom node registration, metrics, aggregation, mock node injection
